data.title: One *good* prompt
data.subtitle: Five rules from Anthropic's own guidance, and one template.

blocks.text: Claude is a brilliant **new hire** with no context. Leave gaps and it fills them with average guesses.
The test: would a colleague new to the task know what to do?

items: Few rules, each with a reason

blocks.new: Three short paragraphs of flowing prose.

blocks.text:
Goal: I need [X] so that [why].
Context: [reader, background].
Good looks like: [length, format, tone] + one example.
Rules: [2 or 3, each with a reason].
If you're unsure, say so. Don't guess.

items: Read it as **[the reader]**: fix it
